description: What a model's names and declaration add (pack.ModelCheck.findings: checkDrawn's hinge markers, checkGroups, checkAnimations, checkLiveries): untextured hinge markers, control groups too long to send, .anim files, liveries. The animations and the liveries are checked in the file's order (WagonModelDecl keeps it); no key of the cases is an array index ("2"), which a JavaScript object would put first. input: namespace (the declaring file's, for unqualified paths), declaration (the wagon model's JSON), files (ns:path -> text), present (locations that are there, contents unread: textures); any other key with a colon is a file too (what input_file reads of the example pack). A location is valid as Minecraft takes it: [a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9/._-]+. expected: the findings in the check's order (pack.ModelCheck.findings), each {severity: error | warning, finding}: code (ModelFinding.Code.key, as the editor names it: missing-texture), subject and index null, params (the names and numbers its line is made of, in the line's order), text (the line).
